# Meta state
Last patch: Minor Update - 09-16-2026 (2026-09-16)

## Thesis
Comeback is dead. With the flat behind-net-worth bounty removed and objective bounties raised, a team that wins lane holds the lead unless it throws hard; tempo beats scaling. Games are decided by early lane bullies and mobile bruisers turning a lead into objectives and picks before late-scaler steroid builds come online. Flyers, on-hit proc carries, and pure-farm econ buys lost their windows.

## Economy and systems
- Comeback bounty removed; 70% of the rerouted value goes to the two poorest players via tick gold. Fed teams now keep leads.
- Guardian bounty +10%, Walker +5%; objective share 30->25%. Respawn at 20m 35->38s.
- Unstable Rift resist is now 10% +1%/min (cap 40% at 30m), not flat 35% — early rifts are real fights.
- Slows cut ~20% globally but now apply 35% air drag; slow-as-CC and anti-air both stronger.
- Stuns/parry pause reload instead of resetting; dashes and light melee no longer break gun cycle (Silver/Abrams smoothing).
- Tunnel breakables spawn/respawn at 3m->5m, delaying early solo farm.

## Archetype standing
- Early tempo / lane bullies: up — winning lane is the win condition.
- Mobile assassins and bruisers (Yamato, Shiv, Holliday): up; picks convert.
- Tanks/frontline (Abrams, Mo & Krill, Billy): stable-to-up; Fortitude/Decay buffed.
- Late scalers (Warden, Wraith, Celeste, Pocket): down; no safety net.
- Flyers/poke (Celeste, Grey Talon, Vindicta): down via air-drag slows.
- Supports (Ivy, Paige): stable-to-up; lanes matter but healing items keep getting trimmed.
- On-hit proc carries (Warden): down; Mercurial+Overflow deleted and Plated Armor now blocks on-hit spirit.

## Watchlist
- Silver: grounded Bola interrupt + stats + gun-cycle boost; biggest winner, but her 46.7% WR is pre-patch.
- Apollo: absent from notes, best snowballer — confirm his WR.
- Warden: does a pure silence-cage build survive the four-item execution?
- Celeste: seven nerfs + air drag; confirm she drops out of A.
- Items: Golden Goose Egg and Veil Walker pick rates — are the deletions real?

## Recent history
- Minor Update - 09-16-2026: comeback souls removed; tempo wins games; Warden/Celeste/Wraith/Viscous gutted, Silver/Paige up.
- Minor Update - 08-22-2026: Celeste and healing-item tuning.
- Minor Update - 08-12-2026: McGinnis/Apollo changes.
- Minor Update - 07-30-2026: Ranked Mode added.
- Minor Update - 07-28-2026: item and hero tuning.

Seven.why: Draft-dependent gun carry: Hollow Point's shred buff sharpens his early lead, but tunnel breakables now spawn later (3m->5m) and tempo invaders punish his slow start.
Seven.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Hollow Point shred +1% is his only tailwind; tunnel farm delayed.

Vindicta.why: Tempo early-gun carry who profits from picks mattering more post-20m and from Hollow Point's shred buff; only her airborne poke is clipped by the new air-drag slows.
Vindicta.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Hollow Point 9->10% shred strengthens her lane pick.

Lady Geist.why: Tanky spirit bruiser with direct buffs (Life Drain T3 heal scaling +0.45, Essence Bomb T3 +4%) who rises as scaler peers fall; still low WR but wins fights on her ult.
Lady Geist.notes: 09-16: Life Drain T3 spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Essence Bomb T3 26->30%.

Abrams.why: Tank initiator helped by the gun-cycle change (weave shots between punches) plus Fortitude/Decay buffs, but the anti-heal meta and a shorter ult window keep him B.
Abrams.notes: 09-16: Infernal Resilience T3 heal 8->9%; Seismic Impact T3 Unstoppable 6->5s.

Wraith.why: Gun carry who lost her safety net: Card Trick heal and resist-shred cut, Slowing Hex CD up, and Plated Armor now eats Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage. Gun build over CC.
Wraith.notes: 09-16: Card Trick heal 75->60 and spirit scaling 0.75->0.5, Diamond resist-shred -8->-7%; Full Auto spirit 0.03->0.045.

Paradox.why: Pick initiator whose Carbine quick-scope poke was trimmed (min multiplier 25->10%, no T3 scaling) and Slowing Hex CD up; still wins on the Echo Shard bomb.
Paradox.notes: 09-16: Kinetic Carbine min multiplier 25->10% and no longer scaled by T3; Slowing Hex cd 27->29s.

Dynamo.why: Ult-initiator with an AoE-CC ult that now cycles faster via Diviner's Kevlar's +10% ult CDR; the tempo meta rewards converting a won lane into picks.

Haze.why: Gun carry whose Fixation buff (headshot stacks 2->3, higher T3 scaling) plus the gun-cycle change make gun Haze the build; only Plated Armor's fix counters her on-hit.
Haze.notes: 09-16: Fixation headshot stacks 2->3 and T3 weapon scaling 0.0003->0.00035.

Holliday.why: Mobile assassin pushed to a gun-hybrid (health/boon 41->43, Crackshot T2 shred, longer lasso) and favored by pick-heavy tempo, but Veil Walker's strip removed a core enabler.
Holliday.notes: 09-16: health/boon 41->43, Crackshot T2 -6% bullet resist 5s, Bounce Pad lasso +1->+1.25s; Veil Walker now a worse slot.

Calico.why: Above-average skirmisher whose early underground farm is pushed back by the 3m->5m breakable timing; still ~50% WR on a high pick rate.
Calico.notes: 09-16 (indirect): later breakables delay her early farm.

Grey Talon.why: Poke/siege carry the tempo meta punishes; new air-drag slows clip his airborne poke and Hollow Point shred can't fix a sub-48% conversion. Low confidence.
Grey Talon.notes: 09-16 (indirect): air-drag slows hurt airborne poke; no direct compensation.

Mo & Krill.why: Underplayed frontline tank that quietly wins: Fortitude regen and Decay duration buffs suit his minute-one brawls and the tempo meta.
Mo & Krill.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Fortitude regen and Decay duration buffed.

Shiv.why: Anti-tank bruiser whose current-HP knives and alt-fire buffs shred exactly the inflated HP pools this patch funnels into fights; the Tankbuster trim is small.
Shiv.notes: 09-16: alt-fire +4% base and per-boon 0.2->0.24; Serrated Knives full-rage 3.5% current HP on impact.

Ivy.why: Support queen with only small Stone Form nerfs; still the best team-sustain and map control at high WR, though healing items keep getting trimmed around her.

Warden.why: Gun carry whose proc build (Mercurial + Spiritual Overflow) is deleted and who lost Veil Walker; bullet/boon and fire-rate scaling cut plus a 30% flask trim. Only a pure silence-cage utility build survives.
Warden.notes: 09-16: bullet/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit 0.25->0.21, flask range/speed -30%, Willpower T3 spirit 2.7->2.1 and debuff resist 40->30%; Mercurial + Overflow + Veil Walker all hit.

Yamato.why: Mobile burst assassin buffed again (Crimson Slash T3 heal scaling +0.4, Flying Slash light-melee 1.0->1.2) atop a tempo meta that loves her Refresher/Unstoppable burst windows.
Yamato.notes: 09-16: Crimson Slash T3 +0.4 heal spirit scaling; Flying Slash light-melee 1.0->1.2.

Viscous.why: Tank/enabler whose Cube cast range 26->20m guts his signature rescue and Puddle Punch cooldown 21->24s cuts dueling; only the Goo Ball T3 scaling helps.
Viscous.notes: 09-16: Cube range 26->20m, Puddle Punch 21->24s, alt-fire growth -10%, Splatter T1 +2->+1.5m; Goo Ball T3 +0.2 spirit.

Pocket.why: Spirit cloak assassin still wants long fights the tempo meta denies; Fortitude's regen is his only item-side help and his WR stays low.
Pocket.notes: 09-16 (indirect): tempo shift further punishes his long-fight scaling.

Vyper.why: Top-WR coin-flip gun carry: Slither T3 barrier and ult cooldown trimmed, Hollow Point buffed; still 1v6s into low-CC drafts and is useless into CC-heavy comps.
Vyper.notes: 09-16: Slither T3 barrier 5->4s, Petrifying Bola cd 105->115s.

Mina.why: Mobile spirit assassin given no compensation for the tempo shift; her kit no longer converts and she needs a rework.
Mina.notes: 09-16 (indirect): no changes to a falling assassin.

Drifter.why: Blind-pickable melee bruiser with built-in anti-heal; Toxic Bullets scaling and Fortitude regen are tailwinds in a brawl-friendly patch.
Drifter.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Toxic Bullets scaling + Fortitude regen buffed.

Venator.why: Gun carry whose ult now works with Ricochet/Split Shot (real late damage), but a mid-40s WR says the no-weak-point kit still doesn't convert in tempo.
Venator.notes: 09-16: Ira Domini now works with Ricochet (all shots bounce) and Split Shot (3 bolts); Weakening Headshot -13->-12%.

Paige.why: Lane-winning support and the patch's clearest winner: heavy-melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read CD/range buffs, and the flyers she feared were nerfed. Slowing Hex is now a real anti-air slow.
Paige.notes: 09-16: heavy-melee spirit 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read T1 -11->-14s and T3 +1->+2m, Rallying Charge collision fixed.

Billy.why: Best frontline: Lifestrike heal+slow buff doubles as anti-air lockdown, and Decay/Fortitude buffs feed his minute-one brawls and AoE front-line.
Billy.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Lifestrike heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30->35%; 48% slow now drags flyers.

Graves.why: Worst-scaling gun carry; health/boon 33->35 and Toxic Bullets/Fortitude buffs help, but her awful base stats still leave her permanently behind until late.

Apollo.why: Absent from notes but the archetype winner: a top early snowballer (ganks, instant clears, escape, flat damage/heal) whose tempo playstyle the economy patch rewards; only his Restorative Locket slot takes a trim.
Apollo.notes: 09-16 (indirect): tempo economy favors his lane-bully snowball; Restorative Locket trimmed.

Silver.why: Biggest winner: Weighted Bola now a grounded anti-flyer interrupt (Phantom-Strike rules), health/boon 28->31, sprint 1.5->2.5, and the gun-cycle change boosts her high-cycle gun.
Silver.notes: 09-16: Weighted Bola grounds/interrupts flyers, health/boon 28->31, sprint 1.5->2.5, Boot Kick/Entangling Bola now only hit heroes/objectives.

Celeste.why: Spirit burst carry hit seven ways (stamina, Light Eater, Dazzling Trick, Shining Wonder, Radiant Daggers) plus the air-drag slow punishing her flying kit; drops out of A.
Celeste.notes: 09-16: stamina cd 5->5.3, Light Eater 20->18% and T3 +25->+22, Dazzling Trick 34->38s, Shining Wonder 16.5->15.5m and T3 bounces +8->+6, Radiant Daggers T2 +80->+70.

Weakening Headshot.notes: 09-16: bullet resist reduction -13->-12%, a nudge. Still core on Venator, whose whole identity is 'no weak point'.

Hollow Point.notes: 09-16: bullet resist reduction 9->10%. The cheap T2 first-gun slot of the tempo meta.

Toxic Bullets.notes: 09-16: spirit scaling 0.005->0.006%. Core burn/anti-heal slot and one of the few real answers to inflated HP.

Shadow Weave.notes: 09-16: now builds from Sprint Boots, sprint 1.5->2, cooldown 45->37s. Cheaper gun-reposition tool that inherits the component Veil Walker lost.

Cultist Sacrifice.notes: 09-16: bounty 180->170%; soul-printing is a tempo tax now that comeback souls are gone.

Ballistic Enchantment.notes: 09-16: duration 14->20s; still fringe, no clear user base.

Spiritual Overflow.notes: 09-16: buildup 35% slower, spirit power 40->30, fire rate 30->25% (on top of 07-28); the Mercurial proc-carry build is dead.

Restorative Locket.notes: 09-16: heal per boon 0.5->0.45, stack range 35->32m; 08-22 spirit resist 10->8%. Still the stamina/utility buy.

Trophy Collector.notes: 09-16: souls/min 18->16; part of the soul-economy trim.

Veil Walker.notes: 09-16: no longer builds from Sprint Boots (lost +2 sprint/regen), movespeed removed when invis drops, spirit power 10->6. Now a pick-hero-only buy.

Fortitude.notes: 09-16: max-health regen 2->2.25%. The default survivability slot on almost every bruiser.

Lifestrike.notes: 09-16: melee-heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30->35%; with slows now affecting air drag its 48% slow is real anti-air lockdown.

Leech.notes: 09-16: bullet+spirit lifesteal 25->28%; still weak — tempo fights end too fast to drain back.

Plated Armor.notes: 09-16 fix: now blocks on-hit spirit damage (Mercurial Magnum, Vindicta Flight, Wraith Full Auto, Tesla/Capacitor). The defensive answer to mixed-damage on-hit carries.

Diviner's Kevlar.notes: 09-16: now grants +10% Ultimate Ability CDR; tilts from generic defense to an ult-uptime enabler for initiation heroes. 07-28: spirit power +35->+40.

Golden Goose Egg.notes: 09-16: damage penalty -10->-15%, souls/min 90->80, stored souls now count toward net worth — effectively unbuyable; deletes the bank-and-hide pattern.

Slowing Hex.notes: 09-16: cooldown 27->29s; slower engage but now a real anti-air slow given the air-drag change.

Radiant Regeneration.notes: 08-22 heal on cast 70->65; 09-16 per-boon scaling 2->1.7 — cumulative nerf to healing supports.

Tankbuster.notes: 07-28 no longer procs off items; 09-16 current-health bonus 8->7.5% — cumulative trim to the anti-tank slot.

Decay.notes: 09-16: DPS -25% but duration +20% — trades burst healing-cut for sustained suppression over longer fights. Still the go-to anti-heal slot.

Mercurial Magnum.notes: 09-16: base bullet damage scaling 0.49->0.38 and base damage 25->20% — no longer a damage engine; the Mercurial+Overflow proc build has no reliable core.

Focus Lens.notes: 09-16: damage 30->35%, cast range 20->25m; still cleansable, so niche.
